subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.subtitle: Sign-up and delivery happen entirely through our Telegram bot — it collects your address, preferences and processes payment.
subscription.basicFeat1: Hygiene products tailored to your cycle
subscription.howStep1: Tap «Subscribe via Telegram» — opens our bot @lowerBsk24_bot.
subscription.howStep2: Bot asks a few questions: tier, hygiene, allergies, diet, care.
subscription.howStep3: You provide a delivery address and pay right in the chat.
subscription.howStep4: Box arrives a couple of days before your cycle — tracking is in the bot too.
subscription.codeHint: Bot sends it after payment. Paste the code below to flip your subscription on.
subscription.codeEmptyBody: Copy the code from the bot's message and paste it here.
subscription.codeInvalidBody: Double-check that you've entered the full code with no spaces. If it's correct, message the bot.
subscription.disclaimer: Payments happen only through the bot. The app only accepts activation codes — no payment data stored.

manage.title: Manage subscription
manage.inactiveHint: No subscription yet. Tap «Open bot» to pick a tier.
manage.botSectionBody: Tier change, address updates, pause and cancellation all happen in the bot. The app's status will update automatically.
manage.disclaimer: Boxes physically ship to the address you provided to the bot during checkout.
